thread:
paul.marketing: Quick: need a concise battlecard for inbound leads that shows why teams pick a serving-first platform vs cloud endpoints, pure LLM APIs, or stitching infra. Also want 2 webinar CTAs targeted at platform PMs and ML engineers.

zoe.ae: Keep it short for SDRs. Top buyer concerns: unpredictable costs, rollout risk, and demo failures under load.

inger.prod: Callout: include a line about contract SLAs and optional private deployments for regulated customers.

sam.content: Draft hero line: 'Serve models with predictable economics and production-ready rollout controls.' Thoughts?

paul.marketing: Good. Tighten to: 'Predictable inference economics. Production rollouts. Minimal ops tax.'

anya.analytics: Bench snapshot (internal): replayed 8k requests (mixed seq up to 1024), dedicated with caching p50=85ms p95=235ms; public_api p50=205ms p95=560ms. Example unit-cost range: public ~ $0.025-0.03/1k; dedicated optimized ~$0.011-0.015/1k. Internal figures only.

zoe.ae: AE snips (very short): 1) 'Why not use cloud endpoints?' Reply: 'Cloud is fast to start but can surprise you on cost and tail latency; Redwood makes those predictable.' 2) 'Why not build infra?' Reply: 'You keep control without the months of infra build and ops maintenance.'

sam.content: Webinar CTAs: PM-focused: 'Live: How routing policies and fallbacks keep SLAs during regional pressure.' Eng-focused: 'Demo: cost/latency tuning — quantization, batching, and cache in practice.'

inger.prod: Add a legal-safe bench blurb for slides: 'Method: mixed real traffic replay, batching & cache enabled. Metrics: p50/p95 latency and normalized cost per 1k tokens. Results vary by model and workload.'

anya.analytics: I'll produce a one-slide scatter (latency vs cost) and a short reproducibility note for the repo.

paul.marketing: Action items: sam to finalize battlecard copy, zoe to prepend AE snips into SDR cadences, anya to deliver visuals and approved bench wording, inger to confirm private-deploy phrasing with sales. Lock copy by COB and run legal check.

bench-bot: compliance reminder: mark cost/case examples as internal-only until legal approves publishable ranges.
